post.summary: Creates the four default channels and one announcement in #general-mod-chat; 200 only after both are stored in Redis.
post.x-idempotency: eventId with a persisted content digest: identical repeat 200 DUPLICATE, different content 409 EVENT_CONFLICT; an interrupted delivery is re-processed with deterministic effects

post.summary: The only score/penalty mutation. reason DECISION, APPEAL_REFUND or DECISION_VOID; a decision causes at most one change of each reason. Session must not score DecisionRecorded again.
